description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'diff --submodule=diff' format support in git. It contains setup of repositories, adding/removing submodules, and various test cases that verify the behavior of git diff with submodules in different states and configurations.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a git repository and commits them with a message indicating addition.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a git commit with a message indicating a specific operation.

methods.name: diff_cmp
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs after normalizing index hashes for comparison.
